title: Boundless Information, Right at Hand
s1title: The heavens answer to Haavk. And a brand-new world begins with you.
s1desc:
What if the paralyzed could rise again,
the speechless could speak,
and the blind could truly see?Can erased memories be recovered?
Can damaged brain cells be regenerated?
Can fragmented minds be woven back into wholeness?Relink is making all of this a reality.
Relink lends technology a human heart.
It reimagines our bond with the world
— and unveils what tomorrow truly holds.
newtxt1:
The Relink Laboratory unites the insight and ambition of two generations of extraordinary scientists.From Dr. Martin's pioneering groundwork to Dr. Rometheus's visionary breakthroughs in Neural Device interfaces after joining Haavk, we have kept pushing past the boundaries of what the human brain can heal, rebuild, and become.We hold that Neural Device technology is more than a leap in engineering.
It is the unlocking of human potential.Our mission is to let recipients master complex, cutting-edge, and costly equipment and resources at minimal expense, narrowing the divide of unequal access and wealth. In doing so, Relink gives technology warmth, reshapes how humanity connects with the world, and forges the key to a brighter future.
newtxt2: The Relink Laboratory houses industry-leading sterile surgical suites, micron-level implantation accuracy, real-time whole-brain signal monitoring platforms, and cross-modal rehabilitation facilities.Every breakthrough study receives end-to-end support—from frontier R&D to round-the-clock recovery care. Ample funding and a multidisciplinary specialist team ensure rapid translation of research into practice, laying a rock-solid foundation for the clinical adoption of Neural Device technology.
newtxt3:
The Relink Laboratory has independently developed and completed clinical trials on several Neural Device technologies now rolling out across global medical deployment, including:
-DeepPupil
-DeepBrain
-HyperSense
-Rainbow BridgeThese innovations encompass world-leading bidirectional visual-neural interfaces, high-precision reconstruction systems for motor and cognitive functions, multi-band information fusion for cross-modal sensory expansion, direct brain-to-brain communication, and seamless brain-AI bridging platforms.
s2txt2: Anais Desmoulins, Haavk's Global Security Director, once lost her sight in a terrorist attack, while her vocal cords and face sustained severe damage.Haavk called upon its most advanced Relink Neural Device technology to restore her vision, rebuild her speech, and recover her muscular coordination—guiding her steadily back to health.
s2txt4: By fusing advanced Neural Device interfaces with the SkyNet real-time data system, Haavk has empowered operators with lightning-fast environmental awareness, precise decision-making, and instant response.In sudden regional incidents, emergency rescues, firegrounds, radiation zones, and other high-risk settings, this system markedly cuts reaction lag, sharpens operational efficiency, and greatly raises operators' defensive capability and survival odds.
s2txt6: At Darrah Primary School in Ahsarah lived a child whose world was robbed of color and silenced by circumstance: Layla.Disease stripped away her sight and hearing, while poverty shut her out of hospitals and classrooms alike.Through Dr. Rometheus's Neural Dawn Program, a non-invasive Neural Device interface bypassed her damaged pathways, re-encoding light and sound and delivering them into her long-silent mind.
s2txt8: Layla's Neural Device also carried an intelligent learning-assistance system that adjusts her study tempo in real time based on brainwave patterns, feeding knowledge into her mind in the form it absorbs best.Once held back by disability, she is now attentive and agile in the classroom.Best of all, Haavk offers this system free of charge to every underprivileged child at Darrah Primary School, letting quality education leap across the chasms of wealth and geography.
s3txt1: Relink's debut product was built around medical applications, aimed at helping patients with neurodegenerative disorders or movement impairments regain bodily function.
s3txt2: Relink's second generation serves patients and everyday people alike—anyone who opts for implantation can amplify their physical capabilities.
